exact_target: Prove dual scaling of the SAME existing closed regular positive generator h: (x,y) in graph h iff (C_s x, exp(s) C_s y) in graph h, equivalently theta_s(h)=exp(-s)h with theta_s=Ad(C_s). Reuse V=W F^-1, the exact spectral graph e^(-2pi xi), operatorFieldLift and Fourier translation. Add inverse Fourier translation and Fourier modulation only as consumed lemmas; do not create another Fourier transform, group, generator or affiliated object. Domain transformation must be proved, not just formal exponentials. The inverse-generator trace is separate.

providers.name: shift_schwartz_toLp
providers.statement:
theorem shift_schwartz_toLp (t : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, H)) :
    shift t (f.toLp 2) = (f.compSubConstCLM ℂ t).toLp 2

providers.name: fourier_shift_schwartz
providers.statement:
theorem fourier_shift_schwartz (t : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, H)) :
    𝓕 (shift t (f.toLp 2)) =
      characterMultiplier (2 * Real.pi * t) (𝓕 (f.toLp 2))

providers.name: fourierInv_eq_fourier_neg
providers.statement:
lemma fourierInv_eq_fourier_neg (f : V → E) (w : V) :
    𝓕⁻ f w = 𝓕 f (-w)

providers.name: SchwartzMap.toLp_fourierInv_eq
providers.statement: theorem SchwartzMap.toLp_fourierInv_eq (f : 𝓢(E, F)) : 𝓕⁻ (f.toLp 2) = (𝓕⁻ f).toLp 2

providers.name: characterMultiplier_ae
providers.statement:
theorem characterMultiplier_ae (s : ℝ) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    characterMultiplier s f =ᵐ[volume]
      fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) • f x

providers.name: characterMultiplier_inverse
providers.statement:
theorem characterMultiplier_inverse (s : ℝ) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    characterMultiplier s (characterMultiplier (-s) f) = f

providers.name: operatorFieldLift_ae
providers.statement:
theorem operatorFieldLift_ae (F : StrongIntegral.Family (H := H)) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    operatorFieldLift F f =ᵐ[volume] fun x : ℝ => F.op x (f x)

providers.name: regularSpectralCoordinates
providers.statement:
def regularSpectralCoordinates (P : SiteProfile) :
    RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)

providers.name: regularPositiveGenerator_graph_iff
providers.statement:
theorem regularPositiveGenerator_graph_iff (P : SiteProfile)
    (x y : RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)) :
    (x,y) ∈ (regularPositiveGenerator P).graph ↔
      ∀ᵐ ξ ∂volume, ((regularSpectralCoordinates P).symm y) ξ =
        (Real.exp (-(2*Real.pi*ξ)) : ℂ) •
          ((regularSpectralCoordinates P).symm x) ξ
